leadText: Roxanne Beck is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of . She was credited under the name of Annie Pondel for the first two seasons. In subsequent seasons, she was credited under her real name.
plainText:
Roxanne Beck is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of . She was credited under the name of Annie Pondel for the first two seasons. In subsequent seasons, she was credited under her real name.

==Pokémon roles==
Beck started voicing characters in during season one. She worked on the series up until she was removed from the credits towards the end of season five. She has played the voices of some of the most well-known characters of the day.
===Animation===
==== ====
=====Humans=====
Giselle

Ramona

Ariene
Naomi

=====Pokémon=====
Brock's Vulpix (EP028)
